title: VAT matrix controlled cleanup execution for incomplete INLAND/VAT19 row
purpose: Execute only the controlled cleanup of the incomplete INLAND/VAT19 VAT Posting Setup row after D10/D11/D12 established the row action, confirmation dialog and cleanup decision. Do not recreate the row in this case.

decisionBasis: D4 Page Inspection proves the row is incomplete.
D3/D5/D8 direct correction routes are blocked and must not be repeated.
D10 proves row-scoped delete actions are visible.
D11 proves a cancellable Ja/Nein dialog.
D12 selects controlled cleanup as the smallest non-repeating next step.
stopIf: The current URL or shell does not show playthru.
The current company cannot be confirmed as UNIVERSAARL-DE.
The focused row does not contain INLAND and VAT19.
More Options does not show a row-scoped delete action.
The dialog text is not the expected Fortfahren und loeschen? / Ja / Nein pattern.
More than one target row is visible or row identity is ambiguous.
Any Preview Posting, Posting, master-data, draft or API path appears.

acceptanceCriteria: Before screenshot/text proves Page 472 and the exact incomplete INLAND/VAT19 row.
Dialog screenshot/text proves the expected confirmation before any Ja click.
If confirmed, after-reopen screenshot/text proves INLAND/VAT19 row absence.
If anything differs, the case is blocked without confirmation.
No recreate/completion is attempted in this case.
No Preview Posting, Posting, master data, draft or API shortcut occurs.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: D12 selected controlled cleanup after D11 proved the guarded Ja/Nein dialog and row survival after Nein.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: The incomplete INLAND/VAT19 row blocks correct VAT matrix setup and direct correction routes are exhausted.
